78320.subject: Data & Insights: Bitcoin and Gold are Correlated
78320.body:
The Data and Insights newsletter brings the highlights of the week from The Block’s Data Dashboard

( https://www.theblock.co/data/crypto-markets/spot )

Presented By:

Bitget ( https://bron.org/?utm_source=TheBlock&utm_medium=Email&utm_campaign=DailyNewsletter )

Gm data bulls! Crypto data is picking up speed, with new highs and interesting trends popping up again. We’re excited to bring you our favorites. Our team recently set up a new newsletter titled " Tokenization Briefing ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters )." With trillions of dollars of real-world assets migrating onto blockchain rails we are introducing a way for readers to keep up to date with market insights and visual analyses on what matters in the world of Tokenization. Sign up *here* ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters ). Our first issue releases next Tuesday so keep an eye out for it in your inboxes!

This week, we’re taking a look at digital asset treasuries and the debasement trade. We’ll also look at the Fear and Greed Index and the revival of Robinhood and Solana. So grab a drink, take a seat, and let's dive in.

1: Looks Good. Send DAT.

( https://www.theblock.co/data/treasuries/crypto-treasuries/cumulative-market-cap-of-public-companies-holding-crypto )

Chart via The Block's Data Dashboard

*Key Insights* provided by The Block Research

* Crypto digital asset treasury companies (DATs) have been among the best-performing crypto equities since the start of the bull trend.

* DATs buy and hold cryptocurrencies to raise capital at a premium and use it as leverage to buy more tokens. Investors are willing to buy DAT shares because these companies take leveraged positions in the underlying assets, which should amplify returns.

* Cumulative market capitalization for these companies is up 10% since mid-August and hovers around $340 billion.

* Performance has varied across the DATs. Established names like Strategy and Bitminer are up 30% and 27%, respectively, generally in line with the price appreciation of the underlying, with Strategy outperforming BTC by 10% since August 17.
* However, new-age DATs with less attention have been some of the best-performing crypto-related assets so far this cycle. Altcoin DATs CYPH and PURR track underlying tokens ZCash and Hype. The tokens have also performed strongly, with HYPE up 36% and ZEC up 56%. PURR and CYPH, on the other hand, have returned 62% and 142%, respectively.

* Crypto DATs are evolving as these companies expand to different tokens. One of the more interesting propositions is a DAT's ability to participate in an ecosystem. Ethereum DATs stake ETH and help secure the network, PURR runs a Hyperliquid validator to vote in governance, and CYPH operates a mining operation to contribute hashrate to the network. These functions were largely unavailable to Strategy since Bitcoin is an unproductive asset, but they give these DATs a unique value proposition within their blockchains.

78307.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption:

Happy Monday! Kevin Warsh’s hawkish Jackson Hole speech pushed rate hike odds to 60% and sent equities and gold lower. BTC still finished the week 0.9% higher, while a burst of speculation on Robinhood Chain drove UNI and the DEX sector sharply higher. 

We then look at Hyperliquid’s decision to open HIP-4 outcome markets to outside builders. Outcome and Skew have each posted a $40M HYPE bond, but incentives have given Outcome a clear early lead.

Over the last week, BTC was the only benchmark to finish in the green, gaining a modest 0.9%. The S&P 500 fell 0.1%, the Nasdaq 100 declined 0.4% and gold was the weakest performer at -3.7%. Much of the selling came on Friday following Kevin Warsh’s speech at Jackson Hole.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/80b67d2a-07b0-4d77-ae2f-3d42b42053ee/image.png?t=1788170899)
Caption: 

Warsh’s hawkish tone caught the market off guard. He [pointed](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/31/jackson-hole-fed-chair-kevin-warsh-hawkish-rate-hikes-analysts.html) to the continued resilience of the US economy and warned that policy may need to respond if disinflation does not progress quickly enough. The odds of a September rate hike have since [risen](https://www.investing.com/central-banks/fed-rate-monitor) from 37% a week ago to 60% today. This repricing weighed on equities and rate-sensitive gold, while BTC gave back part of its earlier gains but still ended the week higher.

Within crypto, DEXs were the strongest sector, gaining 11.4%. The move was led by UNI, which rose 12.8% and accounts for 63% of the index.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ccbe81c1-3aa1-41f4-b52d-56284e2ff7d4/image.png?t=1788170899)
Caption: 

UNI’s rally followed a sharp increase in volumes on Robinhood Chain, driven by meme tokens paired with tokenized equities. Average daily volumes rose close to 150% over the week, with Robinhood Chain accounting for 40% of Uniswap’s total volume on Aug. 29.
